warnings.message: Codex skips a new or changed user hook until it is reviewed and trusted (/hooks; trust is recorded against the hook's hash): trust the harness forbid guard once on this machine, or flags-anywhere forbids hold only in their prefix form until then

forbid write **/.git/hooks/**: Codex takes a glob only for deny, so the "read" downgrade is ".git/hooks/**" at each workspace root; a copy deeper down (<dir>/.git/hooks) stays writable for sandboxed commands

allow command ["pnpm"] not emitted on codex: an execpolicy allow runs outside the sandbox, and an interpreter runs any script there (deny_read and egress hold only inside it); the command runs sandboxed instead
codex reports no cost: max_usd 5 is not metered; the run is bounded by max_turns 200 and a hard kill at max_minutes 60

accepted.message: write **/.git/hooks/**: a filesystem "read" downgrade covers sandboxed commands, not the apply_patch tool
accepted.reason: the write deny downgrades sandboxed commands only; apply_patch is covered by the project hook; the dotfiles merge mcp-restrictions.toml into the prod-db entry they define

accepted.message: tool mcp:prod-db:execute: Codex loads an mcp_servers entry only with its transport (command or url), which the policy does not define, so config.toml cannot carry disabled_tools; the deny is in mcp-restrictions.toml and holds only once merged into the entry that defines prod-db
accepted.reason: the write deny downgrades sandboxed commands only; apply_patch is covered by the project hook; the dotfiles merge mcp-restrictions.toml into the prod-db entry they define

accepted.message: unattended, an ask is a denial; write infra/**: a filesystem "read" downgrade covers sandboxed commands, not the apply_patch tool
accepted.reason: unattended, infra/** is read-only for sandboxed commands and apply_patch there is refused by the project hook; a web search reads public pages and writes nothing

accepted.message: unattended, an ask is a denial; tool web-search has no documented Codex key
accepted.reason: unattended, infra/** is read-only for sandboxed commands and apply_patch there is refused by the project hook; a web search reads public pages and writes nothing

accepted.message: allow rules run outside the sandbox, past deny_read and egress: ["git", ["status", "log", "diff"]]
accepted.reason: git status, log and diff read the forge's object store outside the sandbox; nothing they print is a secret the policy denies

accepted.message: fail_if_unavailable has no documented Codex key
accepted.reason: on the desk, Codex commands read the gh and npm credentials as they did before the masks; elsewhere the launcher refuses to start Codex without its sandbox

notes: mcp-restrictions.toml: merge each mcp_servers.<id>.disabled_tools (prod-db) into the config entry that defines that server; never add a table for a server no entry defines (Codex refuses an entry without command or url)
